cold_open.hook: Nasdaq down 5.52%, AMD cratering 17%—chip stocks are getting obliterated and nobody's pretending it's temporary anymore.

markets.macro_note: Tech rout accelerating; chip stocks in freefall while defensive plays (COST, PEP) barely hold ground.

big_story.story_title: Cloudflare's stock mounts a big comeback after fastest sales surge in nearly 4 years
big_story.angle: One company actually executing in the wreckage—Cloudflare's sales acceleration is proof that growth still matters if you can actually deliver it, not just promise AI magic.

quick_hits.angle: Five9 betting 75% of 2026 revenue on AI while buying Level AI—either visionary or the most expensive way to say 'we panicked.'
T-Mobile CEO's 'welcome to the party' on Elon's wireless play is the corporate equivalent of a smile before the knife fight.
Meta, Google, TikTok suing California AG over teen social media law—three companies that profit from teen engagement suddenly discovering child welfare.
Airbnb's AI travel agent launching mid-2027 is either the future of booking or a very expensive way to say 'we're scared of ChatGPT.'

odd_thing.joke_angle: Melania brokered a Russia-Ukraine agreement—the one person nobody was asking for geopolitical input just casually solved what the State Department couldn't.

yesterday_callback.topic: Figma beat earnings but stock tanked—company is pivoting to AI-first product roadmap and investors hate long-term bets
yesterday_callback.fresh_take: Today's chip rout proves yesterday's thesis: investors are punishing any company that says 'we're investing in AI' instead of 'we're already printing AI money.' Cloudflare gets a pass because it's actually growing revenue—not just the roadmap.

sign_off.callback_target: Cloudflare's sales surge—the one stock that didn't need to promise AI magic to move.
